card.name: Words just before surgical care mentions
card.fires_on: Linking or lead-in words right before a surgical or specialist-care term, such as 'and' before 'surgical evaluation' in C. difficile advice. Also 'required' or 'urgent' before hospitalization or surgical intervention.

modes.label: 'and' before surgical evaluation
modes.description: The word 'and' (or 'surgical') in the C. difficile management list, just before 'surgical evaluation'.
modes.example: protein supplementation, antibacterial treatment of C. difficile ,<< and>> surgical evaluation should be instituted as clinically indicated

modes.label: Wording before urgent care
modes.description: Words like 'required' or 'urgent' that lead into hospitalization or surgical intervention for severe infection.
modes.example: infection requiring<< urgent>> surgical intervention), have occurred in patients receiving

modes.label: Referral wording
modes.description: The word 'for' after 'referral', leading into specialized care.
modes.example: Immediately withhold PADCEV and consider referral<< for>> specialized care for suspected SJS or TEN

card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before a mention of surgery, hospital stay or specialist referral.
